tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description:
Open a URL in your private server-side browser session. `browser_session_label` loads a saved login
    (see browser_session_put) when the session is first created. Costs 1 mcp_call.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot of the current page (JPEG). Costs 1 mcp_call.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click an element by visible text, label or CSS selector. Costs 1 mcp_call.

tools.name: browser_click_at
tools.description: Click at pixel coordinates of the (resized) viewport. Costs 1 mcp_call.

tools.name: browser_fill
tools.description: Type a value into an input identified by label/placeholder/selector. Costs 1 mcp_call.

tools.name: browser_press_key
tools.description: Press a key on the focused element ('Enter', 'Tab', 'Escape', 'Control+a', ...). Costs 1 mcp_call.

tools.name: browser_paste_html
tools.description:
Paste rich text (HTML) into the focused editor as a clipboard paste, keeping formatting
    (rich-text / contenteditable editors). Click the target first. Costs 1 mcp_call.

tools.name: browser_extract_text
tools.description: Extract text from a described area of the page. Costs 1 mcp_call.

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scroll 'up' or 'down'. Costs 1 mcp_call.

tools.name: browser_get_html
tools.description: Return the current page HTML. Costs 1 mcp_call.

tools.name: browser_close_session
tools.description: Close your browser session (free). Idle sessions are closed after 30 minutes.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email through the server SMTP (subject to server allowlists/limits). Costs 1 mcp_call.

tools.name: analyze_json
tools.description: Inspect large JSON: mode summary|schema|value|preview, optional dotted path. Costs 1 mcp_call.

tools.name: pipeline_list
tools.description: List your pipelines.

tools.name: pipeline_get
tools.description: Get one pipeline incl. steps, schedule and inbound trigger URL.

tools.name: pipeline_create
tools.description:
Create a pipeline. See resource webarm://docs/pipeline-steps for the step schema.
    `extra` may carry webhook_url, webhook_secret, webhook_structured_data_only, inbound_trigger_only.

tools.name: pipeline_update
tools.description:
Patch a pipeline. `fields` may contain any of: name, enabled, cron_expr, run_at (null clears), steps,
    task_variables, webhook_url, webhook_secret, clear_webhook_secret, webhook_structured_data_only,
    inbound_trigger_only, regenerate_trigger_token. `steps` replaces the whole step list.

tools.name: pipeline_delete
tools.description: Delete a pipeline and its schedule (restorable later via pipeline_deleted_restore).

tools.name: pipeline_history_list
tools.description:
Change history of a pipeline, newest first: [{id, seq, action (create|update|delete|restore),
    source (manual|assistant|mcp|api), source_detail, changed_fields, created_at, updated_at}].
    Consecutive manual UI edits within a few minutes are merged into one revision. Page with `before_seq`.

tools.name: pipeline_history_get
tools.description: One revision: {revision, snapshot (full pipeline state after that change), diff (vs previous revision)}.

tools.name: pipeline_history_restore
tools.description: Restore a pipeline to the state of a revision (recorded as a new `restore` revision). Returns the pipeline.

tools.name: pipeline_deleted_list
tools.description: Deleted pipelines that can be restored: [{pipeline_id, name, steps_count, deleted_at, source}].

tools.name: pipeline_deleted_restore
tools.description: Re-create a deleted pipeline from its last snapshot (same id, starts disabled, new inbound trigger URL).

tools.name: pipeline_group_list
tools.description: List your sidebar pipeline groups, each with its pipeline_ids. Ungrouped pipelines are in no group.

tools.name: pipeline_group_create
tools.description: Create a sidebar group, optionally moving the given pipelines into it.

tools.name: pipeline_group_update
tools.description: Rename a group and/or set whether it is collapsed in the sidebar.

tools.name: pipeline_group_delete
tools.description: Delete a group. Its pipelines are kept, just ungrouped.

tools.name: pipeline_group_assign
tools.description: Move a pipeline into a group; omit group_id (or pass null) to remove it from its group.

tools.name: pipeline_test_step
tools.description: Run a single step in isolation. `previous_outputs[i]` feeds {{step_{i+1}_output}}.

tools.name: pipeline_run
tools.description:
Start a run (async; returns run_id). Costs the usual pipeline_run credits. Follow with
    pipeline_run_wait or pipeline_run_get.

tools.name: pipeline_run_get
tools.description: Run status (running|cancelling|ok|error|cancelled), current_step_index, per-step results, answer_preview.

tools.name: pipeline_run_wait
tools.description:
Block until the run finishes or timeout_sec (max 600) elapses; returns the latest run state
    (check `status` — still 'running' means timed out).

tools.name: pipeline_runs_list
tools.description: Recent runs of a pipeline (max 50).

tools.name: pipeline_run_cancel
tools.description: Request cancellation of an active run (takes effect between steps).

tools.name: pipeline_builder_chat
tools.description:
Ask the built-in AI pipeline builder (costs builder_call credits). `messages`=[{role,content}],
    `pipeline`=current draft. Returns {text, pipeline}; the draft is NOT saved — pass it to pipeline_create/update.

tools.name: pipeline_debug_chat
tools.description: Ask the AI to analyse a finished run (costs builder_call credits).

tools.name: workflow_list
tools.description: List your workflows (id, name, enabled, cron_expr, graph, inbound_trigger_url, last_run).

tools.name: workflow_get
tools.description: Full workflow incl. graph {nodes, edges} and inbound_trigger_url.

tools.name: workflow_validate
tools.description: Check a graph without saving: returns {ok, error} or {ok, graph (normalized)}. Free.

tools.name: workflow_create
tools.description:
Create a workflow. graph = {nodes, edges} (read webarm://docs/workflows). Pipelines referenced by
    pipeline / for_each nodes must be yours.

tools.name: workflow_update
tools.description: Update fields of a workflow. graph and task_variables replace the stored value entirely.

tools.name: workflow_delete
tools.description: Delete a workflow and its run history (active runs are cancelled). Pipelines are not touched.

tools.name: workflow_run
tools.description:
Start a run (async; returns run_id). Each inner pipeline run costs the usual pipeline_run credits.
    Follow with workflow_run_wait or workflow_run_get.

tools.name: workflow_run_get
tools.description:
Run status (running|waiting|ok|error|cancelled), node_states (per node: status, run_id of the inner
    pipeline run, preview, error, port taken, for_each iterations), output_preview.

tools.name: workflow_run_wait
tools.description:
Block until the run is no longer running (finished, or parked as 'waiting' on a delay/approval) or
    timeout_sec (max 600) elapses; returns the latest run state.

tools.name: workflow_runs_list
tools.description: Recent runs of a workflow (max 100).

tools.name: workflow_run_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a running or waiting run (in-flight pipeline runs stop between steps).

tools.name: workflow_approve
tools.description: Approve (or reject, approve=false) a wait node of kind approval that is waiting in this run.

tools.name: workflow_history_list
tools.description:
Change history of a workflow, newest first: [{id, seq, action (create|update|delete|restore),
    source (manual|assistant|mcp|api), source_detail, changed_fields, created_at, updated_at}].
    Consecutive manual UI edits within a few minutes are merged into one revision. Page with `before_seq`.

tools.name: workflow_history_get
tools.description:
One revision: {revision, snapshot (full workflow state incl. graph after that change),
    diff (vs previous revision: field changes, graph nodes added/removed/modified/moved, edges added/removed)}.

tools.name: workflow_history_restore
tools.description: Restore a workflow to the state of a revision (recorded as a new `restore` revision). Returns the workflow.

tools.name: workflow_deleted_list
tools.description: Deleted workflows that can be restored: [{workflow_id, name, nodes_count, deleted_at, source}].

tools.name: workflow_deleted_restore
tools.description:
Re-create a deleted workflow from its last snapshot (same id, starts disabled, new inbound trigger URL).
    Fails if a pipeline it references no longer exists (restore that pipeline first).

tools.name: workflow_builder_chat
tools.description:
Ask the WebArm workflow assistant to design a new workflow or change an existing one (workflow_id).
    Returns {reply, proposal, changes}; NOTHING is saved. proposal = {name, graph, task_variables, cron_expr,
    new_pipelines: [{key, name, description}], needs, plan}; graph nodes may use pipeline_

tools.name: workflow_builder_create_pipeline
tools.description:
Draft a pipeline with the AI pipeline builder from a description (as in a proposal's new_pipelines)
    and create it. Its first step reads upstream workflow data from {{workflow_input}}. variables = the
    variable names the workflow node passes (keys of its config.variables) so the pipeline uses

tools.name: agent_job_submit
tools.description: Run the browsing agent on a task (async; costs agent_job credits). Jobs are in-memory (lost on restart).

tools.name: agent_job_get
tools.description: Job status/result (queued|running|completed|failed).

tools.name: agent_job_list
tools.description: Recent agent jobs.

tools.name: schedule_list
tools.description: List automations (single-task schedules).

tools.name: schedule_get
tools.description: Automation details plus recent runs.

tools.name: schedule_create
tools.description:
Create an automation. `schedule` follows ScheduleCreate: mode (agent|replay), task_text, target_url,
    webhook_url, cron_expr, run_at, lang, output_json_schema, task_variables, ...

tools.name: schedule_update
tools.description: Patch an automation (ScheduleUpdate fields).

tools.name: schedule_delete
tools.description: Delete an automation.

tools.name: schedule_run
tools.description: Run an automation now (synchronous; costs schedule_run credits).

tools.name: schedule_export
tools.description: Export an automation as portable JSON.

tools.name: schedule_import
tools.description: Import an exported automation.

tools.name: storage_list
tools.description: List your JSON/text stores.

tools.name: storage_read
tools.description: Read a store.

tools.name: storage_write
tools.description: Write a store (mode 'auto' keeps JSON, 'text' stores a string).

tools.name: storage_delete
tools.description: Delete a store.

tools.name: ai_models_list
tools.description: Models available for the ai_agent step (provider, id, tier, credit_multiplier, vision, reasoning).

tools.name: skill_list
tools.description: List your ai_agent skills (name, description, files).

tools.name: skill_get
tools.description: Get one skill with its SKILL.md body and extra files.

tools.name: skill_create
skill_import
tools.description: Create (or with overwrite=true replace) a skill from SKILL.md text with name/description front matter.

tools.name: skill_update
tools.description: Update a skill; only the given fields change (files replaces all extra files).

tools.name: skill_delete
tools.description: Delete a skill.

tools.name: storage_files_list
tools.description: List stored files.

tools.name: storage_file_put
tools.description: Upload a file (base64 content). Size caps: USER_FILES_FILE_MAX_BYTES / per-user total.

tools.name: storage_file_get
tools.description: Download a file as base64 (limited to 8 MiB of base64).

tools.name: storage_file_delete
tools.description: Delete a stored file.

tools.name: browser_session_list
tools.description: List saved logins (Playwright storageState slots).

tools.name: browser_session_get
tools.description: Get a saved storageState.

tools.name: browser_session_put
tools.description: Save a Playwright storageState (stored encrypted).

tools.name: browser_session_delete
tools.description: Delete a saved login.

tools.name: account_me
tools.description: Your account incl. credit balance.

tools.name: credits_history
tools.description:
Credit usage history: balance, 30-day spend by reason, and ledger entries (newest first).
    Each entry has delta, reason (pipeline_run, ai_agent, schedule_run, chat_turn, agent_job, builder_call,
    debug_chat, mcp_usage, purchase, signup_grant, refund, ...), detail (what it was for), balance_aft

tools.name: credit_packs
tools.description: Purchasable credit packs.

tools.name: credits_checkout_url
tools.description: Create a Stripe Checkout URL for a pack; a human must open it to pay.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "send_email" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "pipeline_create" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: browser_navigate, browser_get_html, pipeline_get, credits_checkout_url · Private data: browser_navigate, skill_list, skill_get, skill_create, skill_update, storage_files_list, storage_file_put, storage_file_get, storage_file_delete · Public sink: send_email, workflow_builder_chat, agent_job_submit, storage_file_put · Destructive: pipeline_delete, pipeline_history_list, pipeline_group_delete, pipeline_group_assign, pipeline_test_step, pipeline_run, pipeline_run_get, pipeline_run_wait, pipeline_run_cancel, pipeline_debug_chat, workflow_delete, workflow_run, workflow_run_get, workflow_run_wait, workflow_run_cancel, workflow_approve, workflow_history_list, agent_job_submit, schedule_delete, schedule_run, storage_delete, skill_import, skill_delete, storage_file_delete, browser_session_delete.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
